tasks.title: Add `done <id>` command
criteria: `tasklist done <id>` in cmd/tasklist marks the matching task done, saves it and prints "Completed task #<id>", returning an error when the id is not found, with a test in cmd/tasklist/main_test.go
tasks.expected_output: go test ./cmd/tasklist passes, including TestRunDone and TestRunDoneNotFound

checks.command: sh -c 'export GOCACHE=${MARSHAL_BUILD_DIR:-/tmp}/gocache; grep -q "func TestRunDone" cmd/tasklist/main_test.go && grep -q "Completed task #" cmd/tasklist/main.go && go vet ./cmd/tasklist/ && go test ./cmd/tasklist/'
criteria: `tasklist done <id>` in cmd/tasklist marks the matching task done, saves it and prints "Completed task #<id>", returning an error when the id is not found, with a test in cmd/tasklist/main_test.go

tasks.title: Add task due dates
criteria: internal/task.Task has an optional Due *time.Time field (json:"due,omitempty") with SetDue(due time.Time) and IsOverdue(now time.Time) bool (true only when not Done, Due set and now after Due), with unit tests in internal/task/task_test.go
tasks.expected_output: go test ./internal/task passes, including TestSetDue, TestIsOverdue and TestDueJSON

checks.command: sh -c 'export GOCACHE=${MARSHAL_BUILD_DIR:-/tmp}/gocache; grep -q "func TestIsOverdue" internal/task/task_test.go && grep -q "func TestSetDue" internal/task/task_test.go && grep -q "due,omitempty" internal/task/task.go && go vet ./internal/task/ && go test ./internal/task/'
criteria: internal/task.Task has an optional Due *time.Time field (json:"due,omitempty") with SetDue(due time.Time) and IsOverdue(now time.Time) bool (true only when not Done, Due set and now after Due), with unit tests in internal/task/task_test.go
